data.name: Grove Fisher
data.detailed_description:
Grove Fisher is a relaxing idle game, where you grow your profits by discovering treasures and various species of rare fish!

Key Features:

  • Discover and collect various species of fish

  • Upgrade your ponds to reach magical efficiency

  • Reel up old valuable treasures

  • Improve your abilities by upgrading the skill tree

  • Restart your operation to gain a valuable resource

  • Complete various achievements to get rewards and unlock new features

data.short_description: A relaxing idle game about fishing. Discover dozens of fishes and treasures! Spend your resources on growing your operation and unlocking new varieties of underground life! Achieve goals, buy skills, and mutate rare fish to improve your profits!
